CameraEncryption.description:
Channel encryption the client must configure before joining (Agora
``setEncryptionConfig``).

salt.description: Base64 salt (32 bytes decoded) for the `gcm2` modes; null when not sent.
salt.title: Salt

CameraEncryption.title: CameraEncryption

id.description: Camera id as the vendor names it.
id.title: Id

name.description: A short display name, e.g. `Front left`.
name.title: Name

placement.description: Where the camera sits, if known. A `front_left` and a `front_right` camera form a stereo pair the client may show side by side.

uid.description: Agora uid the mower publishes this camera under, if known. Clients fall back to the first remote user that publishes video.
uid.title: Uid

CameraPlacement.description:
Where a camera sits on the mower. Clients pair ``front_left`` and ``front_right`` for the
side-by-side view and stereo frames (both front cameras of a LUBA 2 AWD X).
CameraPlacement.title: CameraPlacement

CameraQuota.description: The vendor's video budget (Mammotion meters video over 4G only).
CameraQuota.title: CameraQuota

CameraSession.description:
Credentials for one viewer to join the live video of one mower.

Provider ``relay`` needs the ``relay`` endpoint and carries no vendor secrets (``token``
and ``app_id`` empty, no ``encryption``); ``expires_at`` is then the ticket's expiry. Every
other provider has no ``relay`` endpoint.

channel.description: Agora channel name (64 bytes at most).
channel.title: Channel

encryption.description: Set when the channel is encrypted.

expires_at.description: When the token stops working; clients request a new session before.
expires_at.title: Expires At

quota.description: The video budget, when the vendor reports one.

token.description: Short-lived Agora token. Never log it.
token.title: Token

uid.description: The viewer's Agora uid (bound to the token).
uid.title: Uid

CameraSession.title: CameraSession

RelayEndpoint.description: Where and with what a client plays a relay session (``provider`` ``relay``).

heartbeat_seconds.description: How often the client renews the lease while the page is visible.
heartbeat_seconds.title: Heartbeat Seconds

lease_id.description: The viewer's lease; renew and detach name it.
lease_id.title: Lease Id

ticket.description: Short-lived ticket signed by the relay, bound to account, mower, lease and paths. Sent as the WHEP bearer token. Never log it.
ticket.title: Ticket

RelayEndpoint.title: RelayEndpoint

RelayError.description: The error of a relay reply.
RelayError.title: RelayError

RelayErrorCode.description: Why the relay gave no lease.
RelayErrorCode.title: RelayErrorCode

RelayTile.description: One camera as the relay serves it: a WHEP endpoint per camera.

available.description: Whether this camera delivers video: true once its stream appeared, false when it has not appeared a while after the session went live (a camera the vendor lists but the mower never publishes), null while not known yet. Clients offer only cameras that are not false.
available.title: Available

whep_url.description: WHEP endpoint of this camera: an absolute path on the MowDeck origin or an `http(s)` URL. The path carries a random session token, never the mower id.
whep_url.title: Whep Url

RelayTile.title: RelayTile

description: Reply to :class:`RelayRenewRequest`: the same lease with a fresh ticket, or an error.
title: RelayRenewReply
